layers.legend: Actual Unreal final images. Identical camera, exposure, and display path; no per-image brightness normalization.
Cyan: active uniform screen probes. Orange with white rings: active adaptive probes. Points are projected from captured 3D positions; they are not extra scene lights.

Blue → cyan → green → yellow → white: increasing response. Filled lobe faces pass the scene-depth test; magenta wire outlines show hidden function geometry. Radius and colors keep one scale within each experiment. Signed coefficients remain in the data.

Yellow: a representative subset of captured card bounds. The card-center depth test uses a tolerance of max(10 cm, 2% of scene depth); outlines can extend behind foreground geometry. Complete geometry and page arrays are retained separately.

Blue: clipmap 0, cell spacing about 104.17 cm. The other three clipmaps have no active cells in these captures. Marker color and size stay fixed; the age chart shows update activity even when positions do not move.

Green: up-facing normals. Orange: down-facing normals. Blue: X-dominant wall normals. Pink: Y-dominant wall normals. All positions come from captured card depth; color is orientation, not illumination.

screen-probes.alt: Active screen probes projected onto the actual Sponza scene at warm baseline; cyan uniform samples and orange adaptive samples.
screen-probes.caption: 3,706 active probes, reconstructed from their captured translated-world positions. The native screenshot and the captured camera provide the scene context. Finite entries outside the active allocation are excluded.

screen-sh.alt: Ten three-dimensional diffuse-response lobes reconstructed from captured screen-probe SH at warm baseline, anchored to floor and arcade samples in Sponza.
screen-sh.caption: Ten captured samples. Radius = 60 cm × clamp(response luminance / 1.4454, 0, 1); the same scale applies to every observation in this experiment. Magenta outlines expose depth-occluded parts of these function graphs. Green and pink center marks identify floor and arcade samples.

facts.SH data: 27 signed coefficients per active probe: R0…R8, G0…G8, B0…B8
facts.Evaluated quantity: View-pre-exposed unit-albedo diffuse response D(n); AO=1
facts.Display range: 0 to 1.4454 response luminance; negative values clipped only for display
facts.Correspondence: Nearest world-position samples with recorded distance and normal compatibility; atlas index is not physical identity

cards.alt: Captured Sponza cards placement, warm baseline
cards.caption: Projected bounds of captured cards. Yellow emphasizes a spatially distributed subset; the complete card and page records remain available. Bounds describe a capture domain, not an extra polygonal surface.

facts.Visibility rule: Card-center depth test; this does not clip every outline edge against scene geometry

world-cache.alt: Captured Sponza world-cache placement, warm baseline
world-cache.caption: Main world-cache probe centers projected into the native scene image. All active cells in this capture belong to the finest clipmap, shown in blue. A point marks a stored sampling location, not a light source.

facts.Probe offset: Captured sub-cell offsets are zero in these states
facts.Identity: Clipmap level + world cell; physical slot is tracked separately
